content: My lower back hurts after deadlifts, should I keep going?

⚠️ Alex, don't push through pain. Drop the deadlift load right now, or swap in something easier on your back, like hip thrusts or leg curls, and only train pain-free. If the pain is sharp, shoots down your leg, or lasts more than a few days, stop deadlifting and see a doctor or physio. I can't diagnose it from here.

Do you want me to swap deadlifts out of today's workout, or look at your recent training to see if load has jumped?
